name: subject_verb_agreement
description: Choose 'is' vs 'are' to agree with a singular/plural subject across an attractor prepositional phrase. Control: same sentences ending with a modal, answer ' be'.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
N=[('key','keys'),('dog','dogs'),('book','books'),('teacher','teachers'),('car','cars'),('painting','paintings'),('box','boxes'),('child','children'),('student','students'),('bottle','bottles'),('picture','pictures'),('woman','women')]
A=['cabinet','cabinets','house','houses','table','tables','window','windows','garden','gardens']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    s,p=random.choice(N); pl=random.random()<0.5; a=random.choice(A)
    prep=random.choice(['near','behind','next to','beside'])
    items.append({"prompt":f"The {p if pl else s} {prep} the {a}","answer":" are" if pl else " is"})
for i in range(120):
    s,p=random.choice(N); pl=random.random()<0.5; a=random.choice(A)
    prep=random.choice(['near','behind','next to','beside'])
    m=random.choice(['will','must','should','might'])
    control.append({"prompt":f"The {p if pl else s} {prep} the {a} {m}","answer":" be"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
